topics.title: Machine kya hai?
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Acha Student, kabhi socha hai ke humari tazurbaat mein machines kis tarah se madad karti hain? Jaise rickshaw jo hamesha bazaar tak humein le jaata hai, ya woh chashni jo biryani ko aur bhi mazaydaar banati hai. Chalo dekhte hain ke machines kya hoti hain!

## SAMJHAO
Machine ek aisi cheez hai jo kaam ko asan banane ke liye banayi jati hai. Ye kisi bhi tareeqe se kaam kar sakti hain, jaise kuch machines khud chalti hain aur kuch ko humein chalana padta hai. Machines ke khoj se insaan ki zindagi mein bohot badlav aaye hain.

Ek simple machine ka udaharan hai lever. Lever ek aisi rod hai jo ek point par ghoomti hai, jisse humein mushkil kaamon ko asan karne mein madad milti hai. Jese ek taraf se zyada weight hon aur doosri taraf thoda, to lever usse upar karne mein madad karta hai.

Dusra udaharan hai wheel. Wheel ek gol cheez hai jo ghoom sakti hai. Jab hum ek wheel ko ghoomate hain, to iski madad se ek bhaari cheez asaani se chal sakti hai. Jaise ek cycle ya rickshaw, ye sab wheel ki wajah se chalte hain.

In dono machines ka istamal hum rozana ki zindagi mein karte hain. Ye machines humari zindagi ko aasan banati hain aur humein kaam karne mein madad karti hain.

## MISAAL
Socho, jab tum bazaar jaate ho aur wahan sabzi bechne wale logo ko dekhte ho. Woh naujawan lever ka istemal karke bhaari bhaari sabzi ko upar uthaate hain. Jab woh sabzi ko bech rahe hote hain, tab unka kaam lever ki wajah se asan hota hai, aur unhe zyada mehnat nahi karni padti. 

## KARO
Ab tum ghar ya school mein ek chhoti si activity kar sakte ho. Koi choti si cheez, jaise ek kitaab ya khilona, uthao. Usko ek chhoti si rod ya stick par rakh kar, usko ek taraf se push karo. Dekho ke kaise wo cheez aasani se uthti hai, jaise lever ka kaam. Ab tum socho ke agar bina lever ke tumhe woh cheez uthani hoti, to kitni mushkil hoti!

## SAWAAL
1. Machine kya hoti hai? Thoda samjhao.
2. Lever aur wheel ka kya kaam hai?
3. Apne aas paas kisi machine ka udaharan do aur batayein ke wo kaise kaam karti hai.

Robotics Ustaad

topics.title: Robot kya karta?
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Aaj hum baat karne wale hain robots ke baare mein! Socho agar tumhara chhota bhai ya behan ek robot hota, to kya woh tumhare ghar ki saaf safai kar sakta tha? Ya phir kya woh tumhare saath cricket khel sakta tha?

## SAMJHAO
Robots aise machines hain jo logon ki madad karte hain. Yeh machines kuch khaas kaam karne ke liye design kiye gaye hain. Jab bhi koi kaam repeat hota hai ya mushkil hota hai, wahan robot aata hai. Robot ek computer ki tarah hai jo kuch programs ke zariye kaam karta hai.

Robots bahut tarah ke hote hain. Koi robot ghar ki cleaning karta hai, jaise vacuum cleaner robot. Dusre robots manufacturing plants mein kaam karte hain, jahan yeh cheezen assemble karne mein madad karte hain. Kayi robots medical field mein bhi hain jo doctors ki madad karte hain surgeries mein.

Packaged meals banane wale restaurants mein bhi robots hotay hain jo khaana tayyar karne ka kaam karte hain. Yeh sab robots humein zindagi ko aasaan banane mein madad karte hain. Iska matlab hai ki robots sirf ek machine nahi hain, balki yeh humare doston ki tarah hote hain jo har waqt madad karte hain!

Hamari zindagi mein robots ki kami nahi hai, chahe woh ghar ho, school ya bazaar. Yeh humare kaam ko tezi se karne mein madad karte hain aur humein zyada waqt dete hain apne hobbies ya doston ke saath guzaarne ke liye.

## MISAAL
Imagine karo, tumhe apne ghar se bazaar jaana hai biryani kharidne ke liye. Ek robot rickshaw tumhe bazaar tak le ja sakta hai, saath hi traffic ka khayal rakhte hue. Jab tum bazaar pahunchtay ho, robot khud bhi items kharid kar tumhara kaam asaan kar sakta hai, jaise kuch samaan uthana ya payment karna. 

## KARO
Ghar par ek choti si activity karo! Ek box ya toy se ek chhota robot banao. Us box ko design karne ke liye paper, markers, aur glue use kar sakte ho. Is robot ka naam rakho, aur socho ke yeh kya kya kar sakta hai. Fir us robot ka ek khalaasan likho ke yeh kis kis kaam mein aata. Jaise, "Mera robot khana bana sakta hai" ya "Mera robot kis kis tarah se madad kar sakta hai."

## SAWAAL
1. Robot kya hota hai? Ek do examples do.
2. Tumhara robot kya kar sakta hai? Do kaam batao.
3. Robots kis kis jagah par istemal hote hain? 

Robotics Ustaad.

topics.title: Sensor dost
topics.description: Sensors — robot ki aankhein aur kaan
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Bachon, kya aap ne kabhi socha hai ke humari robot dost kaise duniya ko dekhte hain? Kya aap jaante hain ke unhon ki aankhein aur kaan kya hain? Chalo, aaj hum Sensors ke bare mein seekhte hain!

## SAMJHAO
Sensors wo chizain hain jo robots ko feel karne aur samajhne mein madad deti hain. Jaise insaanon ke paas aankhein hoti hain jo unhein dekhne mein madad deti hain, waise hi robots ke paas Sensors hote hain jo unhein duniya ka pata dete hain. 

Aankhein dekhne ke liye hoti hain, lekin kuch robots kaan bhi rakhte hain jo unhein sunne mein madad karte hain. Yeh Sensors bahut chhote hote hain, lekin inki madad se robots aasani se samajh sakte hain ke unhein kya karna hai. 

Misaal ke taur par, agar ek robot ko kisi cheez ka samna karna hai, to wo apni Sensors ka istemal karke jaan lega ke vo cheez kya hai. Yeh waise hi hai jaise hum akash mein chand ko dekhte hain ya bhi koi awaz sunte hain. 

Pakistan mein aksar chhoti chhoti robots banai ja rahi hain jinmein yeh Sensors istemal kiye ja rahe hain. In Sensors ki madad se robots akelay kaam karte hain.

## MISAAL
Socho, ek chhoti si robot jo bazaar mein chakkar laga rahi hai. Uske paas ek Sensor hai jo use yeh bata raha hai ke log uske aas paas hain ya koi cheez uske raste mein aa rahi hai. Jaise hi koi customer aata hai, robot use scan karti hai aur agar usse kisi cheez ki zarurat hai to wo khud hi us customer ki taraf jaati hai!

## KARO
Ab aapko ek chhoti si activity karni hai. Ghar par ya school mein chhoti chhoti cheezain chunain, jaise ek khilauna, kitab, ya ek phool. Phir dekhein ke woh cheezain kaise alag alag jagah par rakhkar aap unhein dekh sakte hain bina unhein haath lagaye. Yeh aapke liye Sensors ko samajhne ka aik tareeqa hoga!

## SAWAAL
1. Sensors kya hain aur yeh robots ko kaise madad dete hain?
2. Kya sensors robots ki aankhein hain, ya kuch aur?
3. Aapke khayal se, ek robot bazaar mein kaise kaam karta hai?

Robotics Ustaad

topics.title: Motor chalo!
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Bachon, kya aapne kabhi socha hai ke aapke ghar ke fan ya rickshaw kaise ghoomta hai? Yeh sab kuch motor ki wajah se hota hai! Aaj hum seekhenge "Motor chalo!" aur dekhenge ke yeh motors kis tarah se ghoomti hain.

## SAMJHAO
Chalo, sabse pehle samajhte hain ke motor kya hota hai. Motor aik aisi machine hai jo energy ko movement mein tabdeel karti hai. Jab aap kisi motor ko power dete hain, to yeh energy se ghoomna shuru karti hai. 

Ab baat karte hain ke motor kaise kaam karti hai. Motor ke andar do main cheezein hoti hain: stator aur rotor. Stator woh hota hai jo kahin nahi hila, jabke rotor woh hota hai jo ghoomta hai. Jab stator aur rotor ko electricity milti hai, to rotor ghoomta hai!

Electric motor ko chalane ke liye humein power ki zarurat hoti hai. Yeh power 220 volts ki electricity ya batteries se mil sakti hai. Jab hum switch on karte hain, to power motor tak pohanchti hai aur yeh ghoomne lagti hai.

Matlab yeh, agar hum koi chhoti si robot banaen jisme motor ho, to woh bhi ghoom sakti hai! Hum yeh kar sakte hain apne chhote projects mein. Yani, motor sirf machines mein nahi, balki humare daily life mein bhi bahut important hai.

## MISAAL
Agar aap bazaar mein jaayen, to wahan aapko bohot si cheezein chalte-hue nazar aati hain. Jaise ke rickshaw, jo motor ki wajah se chalta hai. Jab rickshaw ki motor on hoti hai, to yeh aage badhta hai aur aapka safar asaan banata hai. 

## KARO
Ab hum ek simple activity karte hain. Aapko ghar par aik chhoti si toy car ki motor ko dekhna hai. Dekhein ke jab aap battery lagate hain, to woh kaise ghoomti hai. Agar aapke paas motor nahi hai, to aap apne cycle ka bell bhi dekh sakte hain - jab aap usay dabaate hain, to yeh kyu ghoomta hai!

## SAWAAL
1. Motor ka kya kaam hai?
2. Stator aur rotor mein kya faraq hai?
3. Aapne kis cheez ki motor dekhi aur usay kaise chalaya?

Khuda Hafiz, 
Robotics Ustaad

topics.title: Traffic light
topics.description: Traffic signal kaise kaam karta hai
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Kya aap ne kabhi socha hai ke traffic light, jo hum har roz dekhte hain, kaise kaam karti hai? Agar ye na hoti, toh logon ka traffic kitna zyada messy hota! Socho, agar aap ko bazaar jatey waqt traffic ka dhyan nahi rakhna hota, toh kya hota?

## SAMJHAO
Traffic light ek aisi system hai jo gaadiyon aur pedestrian (logon) ko sahi waqt par rukne ya chalne ka signal deti hai. Is mein teen rang hotay hain: laal, peela aur hara.

Jab traffic light laal hoti hai, toh iska matlab hai ke gaadiyon ko rukna hai. Is waqt pedestrians ko chalne ki ijaazat hoti hai. Toh isi liye, jab aap laal light dekhte hain, toh aapko khud ko safe rakhna chahiye aur ruk jana chahiye.

Phir jab traffic light peeli hoti hai, toh iska matlab hota hai ke gaadiyon ko tayar hona chahiye. Ye signal unhain batata hai ke kuch hi der mein light hara hone wali hai. Is waqt, agar aap odd bikhar rahe hain, toh aapko thoda sochna chahiye ke aage badhna hai ya nahi.

Aakhir mein, jab traffic light hara hoti hai, toh gaadiyon ko chalne ka signal diya jata hai. Ye waqt hota hai jab gaadiyan aage barh sakti hain, aur pedestrians ko ruk jana chahiye.

Is trah se, traffic light har kisi ko yahaan tak sahi waqt par chalne ka aur rukne ka mauka deti hai, jisse traffic safe aur organized rehta hai.

## MISAAL
Jab aap bazaar jate hain, toh aap dekhte hain ke har taraf log hain aur gaadiyan chal rahi hain. Traffic lights sunischit karti hain ke sab kuch order mein ho. Agar aap bazaar ke charon taraf traffic lights ko dhyan se dekhein, toh aap samjhein ge ke kab logon ko chalna hai aur kab gaadiyon ko rukna hai. Is se bazaar mein confusion nahi hoti.

## KARO
Ghar ya school mein, ek simple traffic light banane ki activity karein. Aapko sirf colors ke paper aur kuch sticks chahiye honge. Laal, peela aur hara rang ka paper lein aur inhein choti choti circles mein kaat kar sticks par chipka dein. Phir, jab aapke dost ya family members aakar dekhein, aap unhein samjha sakte hain ke kaise traffic lights kaam karti hain.

## SAWAAL
1. Traffic light mein kitne rang hotay hain aur unka kya matlab hai?
2. Jab traffic light peeli hoti hai, toh humein kya karna chahiye?
3. Traffic light ka kya faida hai jab hum bazaar ya sadak par jaate hain?

Robotics Ustaad

questions.explanation: Laal rang hamesha rukne ka ishara deta hai.

questions.explanation: Peela rang tayyari ya dekhne ka ishara hota hai.

questions.explanation: Hara rang chalu hone ka sign hai.

questions.a: Trafik ko behtar karne ke liye
questions.explanation: Traffic light se sadak par traffic ka flow behtar hota hai.

questions.q: Traffic light par hamesha kaun dekhta hai?
questions.explanation: Driver hi signal par nazar rakhte hain taake wo sahih faisla kar sake.

topics.text_simple: Traffic light teen rangon mein hoti hai: laal, peela aur hara. Jab laal hoti hai, toh gaadiyan rukti hain. Peela aata hai, toh gaadiyan tayar hoti hain. Jab hara hota hai, toh gaadiyan chalti hain. Ye sab logon aur gaadiyon ko safe rakhne ke liye hai.

topics.title: Toy robot

# Toy Robot — Apna Toy Robot Design Karo

## HOOK
Kya aapne kabhi socha hai ke ek robot humari help kaisa kar sakta hai? Khayal kijiye agar aapka khilona robot aapke liye ghar ka kaam kar sake, ya aapke liye khana la sakta ho! 

## SAMJHAO
Aaj hum baat karenge toy robots ke bare mein. Toy robots wo chhote chhote machines hote hain jo humein khelne ke liye maza dete hain. Yeh robots kuch kaam kar sakte hain, jaise chalna, gaana gaana, ya bolna. 

Har toy robot ka apna design hota hai. Kuch robots sirf chal sakte hain, jabke kuch robots ko hum remote se control kar sakte hain. Yeh robots aksar battery se chalate hain, aur unke andar chhoti chhoti chips hoti hain jo unhein commands deti hain.

Ab sochiye, agar aap apna khud ka toy robot design kar sakte to wo kaisa hoga? Aap apne robot ko kis color ka banana chahenge? Kya wo gaana gaayega ya dance karega? Yeh sab sochne ki zaroorat hai jab aap apne robot ka design karte hain.

Ek toy robot ko design karne mein creativity bahut zaroori hai. Aap jo bhi design karain, usay banana ek fun activity hoti hai jismein aap apne doston aur family ke sath milkar kaam kar sakte hain.

## MISAAL
Agar hum Pakistan ki taraf dekhein, to Bachay jo bazaar se khilone lete hain, unmein bahut se toy robots hote hain. Kahi baar yeh robots sirf chalne ya bolne ka kaam karte hain. Aise khilone bazaar mein bahut popular hote hain, aur bachay inhein kharid kar khush hote hain!

## KARO
Chalo ab milkar apna khud ka toy robot design karte hain! Is activity ke liye aap ko kuch chhoti chhoti cheezen chahiye: ek cardboard box, rang-birange color papers, scissors, aur glue. 

1. Sab se pehle, cardboard box ko lein aur usay apne robot ka body banayein.
2. Ab us par apne pasand ke colors ka paper chipkayein.
3. Aankhein aur mooh banane ke liye aur bhi chhoti cheezen jaise buttons ya stickers use karein.
4. Robot ki arms aur legs bananay ke liye aap lambi paper strips ya straw use kar sakte hain.
5. Jab aapka robot tayar ho jaye, to ise apne doston ke sath share karein!

## SAWAAL
1. Toy robot kya hota hai?
2. Aap apne robot ko kaise design kar sakte hain?
3. Pakistan ke kis bazaar mein aapne toy robots dekhe hain?

Asha hai aapko yeh lesson pasand aaya hoga aur aap apne toy robot design karke enjoy karenge!
